name: RC-B10-0074/2025 – After § 14 – Am 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s disinformation and historical falsification to justify its war of aggression against Ukraine
part_text: 14b. Emphasises that painful, unresolved issues, such as the 1943-45 Volyn massacre, are also being exploited by Russia to sow division, and calls on the Ukrainian authorities to seriously address this problem, recognising the need to conduct a search for the victims, exhume their remains and ensure their proper burial;
